text: Ans Westra's Washday at the Pā, a school bulletin of photographs of the home life of a rural Maori family, was published by the School Publications Branch of the Ministry of Education in July 1964. The Maori Women's Welfare League and other groups objected that some photographs were not typical of Maori living conditions. On 3 August 1964 the Minister of Education, Mr Arthur Kinsella, ordered the original version withdrawn, and all 38,000 copies were withdrawn from circulation.
meta_description: Ans Westra's Washday at the Pā was withdrawn in 1964 on the Minister of Education's order, after groups objected to its photographs.
changes: Added publication in July 1964, the 3 August date and the bulletin description from the sources.
